messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

I've drafted the graph and saved it. It has five parts: the user, the web app and users database inside your backend, and the email service outside it. The flow runs from the user's forgotten-password request, to the account lookup, to the emailed one-time link, and back to the user, who sets a new password in the app.

The draft assumes the email service is third-party, so it sits outside your system, and that the new password is saved straight to the users database.

Is the graph right, or should anything change?
The graph looks good. I approve it.
